basic_info.description: Mediterranean Revival 3-bed, 2-bath Mission Terrace home blending exceptionally well-maintained 1930s period detail and sophisticated contemporary styling, including air conditioning! Curb appeal, Graceful foyer. LR w/working fireplace, elegant arched window, period sconces, wood ceiling beams w/whimsical details. DR w/sleek custom walnut built-ins. Newly refinished floors upstairs including original parquet w/mahogany inlays. Contemporary kitchen w/generous skylight, premium appliances, abundant cabinet and counter space, bar seating. Delightful center patio flood the kitchen w/light. 2-nicely sized BRs overlook the garden. Full bath w/tub, walk-in shower and beautifully preserved vintage tile completes the main floor. Downstairs is a spacious primary BR w/French doors to the garden. Sleek modern bath w/walk-in shower. Laundry room w/ side-by-side W/D. Lush and private backyard w/mature trees and plants, stone patio and low maintenance turf lawn. 2-car garage w/ample storage space. Custom closet built-ins in all BRs. Mission Terrace, home to Balboa Park, is a beloved residential neighborhood known for its warm community. Near Ocean Avenue, Mission St, and Glen Park commercial corridors. Close to Balboa and Glen Park BARTs, Muni lines, and easy freeway access.
